title: Rust: Rule 5 decompression
description: Implement Rule 5 OSCORE decompression in Rust. Acceptance: decompresses to original headers, cross-validates.
notes: Implemented strict Rust Rule 5 inverse validation in rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs and focused tests in rust/lichen-schc/tests/rule5_decompression.rs. Rule 5/6 residues now must reconstruct exactly one structurally valid RFC8613 Object-Security option; plaintext or malformed tails fail closed. Plaintext Rule 0/1 residues likewise reject valid OSCORE content, preserving rule-ID/profile separation and Python parity. Evidence covers canonical shared oscore_linklocal bytes, independently packed field extremes and recompression, every residue truncation length, both nonzero padding bits, absent/reserved/truncated/invalid/duplicate OSCORE tails, reserved/unavailable TKL, exact 1500-byte embedded CoAP buffer boundary, one-over rejection, and atomic undersized-output failure. Validation passed: cargo fmt --package lichen-schc -- --check; cargo check -p lichen-schc --no-default-features; cargo test -p lichen-schc --lib --test rule5_compression --test rule5_decompression --test shared_vectors => 71 + 6 + 8 + 3 passed; scoped cargo clippy -D warnings passed; git diff --check passed. Untracked link_layer_integration from another worker remains intentionally excluded because it lacks required feature gating.
close_reason: Rust Rule 5 decompression now enforces the OSCORE profile and passes canonical, malformed, padding, truncation, and output-boundary coverage
